description: Worker Python independente com ReportJob diário consolidado (CSV de atrasos + um e-mail via SMTP/destinatários), horário configurável no admin, stub de importação e idempotência via prb_job_runs.

userStories.title: Esqueleto do worker e registry de jobs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a worker/ CLI package with a job registry so batch routines run without coupling to the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Package worker/ with CLI: python -m worker list and python -m worker run <job_id> [--force] [--date YYYY-MM-DD] [--dry-run] [--if-due]
Registry registers jobs by stable job_id
Job import_deliveries exists as documented stub (no API, no delivery writes)
Worker reuses app.config.settings / project venv
Documentation complete
userStories.notes: worker/ CLI list+run; import_deliveries stub; docs/servico-jobs.md

userStories.title: Persistência de execução e idempotência
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the daily job not to resend the same report on the same business day without need, with an auditable run history.
acceptanceCriteria: Incremental migration prb_job_runs with prb_* audit fields and indexes on (job_id, business_date, status)
If success exists for (report_overdue_daily, business_date) without --force, job exits without resend
Each run stores status (running/success/failed/skipped), timestamps, error message, basic metrics
Audit table/trigger for job runs or documented append-only rationale
Tests pass

userStories.title: Geração do CSV consolidado de atrasos
userStories.description: As operations, I want one CSV with all overdue deliveries across all branches for daily follow-up.
acceptanceCriteria: Job report_overdue_daily reads dados/entregas_relatorio.csv with BI-aligned overdue rules via limpeza
Writes one consolidated CSV to storage/reports/YYYY-MM-DD/atrasos_consolidado.csv
Minimum columns: delivery code, client, branch, expected date, reference date, days late, status, carrier when available, other useful processed fields
--dry-run produces CSV or counts without sending email
Tests pass

userStories.title: Envio de e-mail único com anexo
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the consolidated report emailed automatically to daily recipients using configured SMTP.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses default SMTP via SmtpSettingsService / MailDispatchService
Recipients: enabled with receive_daily=true via EmailRecipientService
Sends one email (not per branch) with consolidated CSV attached
Subject/body include reference date and totals
SMTP failure marks run failed and does not mark success
SMTP password decrypted only in memory via secret_box
Tests pass
userStories.notes: worker/adapters/mailer.py; envio real depende de SMTP/destinatários cadastrados

userStories.title: Horário configurável nas Configurações
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to set the daily trigger time (default 07:00) so tests and production can adjust without code redeploy.
acceptanceCriteria: prb_* schedule settings table with job_id, local HH:MM, timezone default America/Sao_Paulo, enabled, audit fields
Default seed: report_overdue_daily at 07:00 America/Sao_Paulo enabled=true
Admin FastAPI endpoints to get/update schedule (admin only)
React admin Configurações page to edit time and enabled flag
CLI --if-due only runs when configured local time reached and no success yet for business_date
CLI without --if-due ignores time window for local testing
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: API /settings/schedules + SchedulePage; typecheck OK; browser MCP não usado nesta sessão

userStories.title: Deploy local e artefatos VPS
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to run the job locally now and have systemd units ready for VPS after deploy.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/servico-jobs.md updated with local test commands
systemd service+timer invoking python -m worker run report_overdue_daily --if-due on a suitable interval (e.g. every 15 min)
.gitignore covers generated storage/reports/ (or clear versioning policy)
Documentation complete
